supporting_observations.claim: Failed logons for svc-inventory begin at 13:34 and recur at roughly one-minute intervals through 13:49. This cadence is consistent with the stated InventorySync job, which runs every minute and re-authenticates each run, and the failures begin after the scheduled 13:30 password rotation.

The failed network logons identify FILE-BLU-01 as the workstation, and the repeated requests use the same source IP, 10.54.20.20; the evidence therefore points to recurring activity associated with the inventory job's host rather than showing repeated attempts from varied sources.

The NTLM validation records report status 0xc000006a, and the Kerberos pre-authentication failures report status 0x18, supporting incorrect or invalid credentials rather than successful authentication in these events.

An earlier explicit-credentials event on FILE-BLU-01 targeted svc-inventory using PowerShell under SYSTEM; it establishes credential use on that host but does not, by itself, establish malicious activity or explain the later failures.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records end at 13:49 UTC, so they do not cover the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The records show failed authentication attempts but do not include service-job execution logs, password-rotation records, or evidence that the job was updated.
claims_not_established: Whether the scheduled password rotation completed at 13:30 UTC and when the InventorySync job was updated.
Whether svc-inventory authenticated successfully later in the requested window.
Whether the source IP 10.54.20.20 maps exclusively to FILE-BLU-01.
additional_evidence_needed: For operational confirmation, check the password-rotation/change record and InventorySync job update history, and verify authentication/job status after 13:49 UTC.
